description: This file defines the MonkeyNoopEvent class, a subclass of MonkeyEvent, representing a no-operation event within the Android monkey testing framework. It overrides the injectEvent method to perform no action, primarily serving as a placeholder or a do-nothing event.

classes.name: MonkeyNoopEvent
classes.description: A subclass of MonkeyEvent representing a no-operation (noop) event in the Android monkey testing framework.

methods.name: MonkeyNoopEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event as a noop event by passing the appropriate event type to its superclass.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Overrides the injectEvent method to perform no action and return success status. If verbose > 1, logs 'NOOP' to the output.
